name: What is the process for a custom home remodeling project?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for a custom home remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our remodeling process typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. This is followed by design and planning, where we develop detailed plans and material selections. Once designs are finalized and permits secured, construction begins, managed by our team. Throughout construction, we maintain open communication and conduct regular check-ins. The project concludes with a final walk-through and handover.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, design, planning, permitting, construction management, and a final walkthrough. We ensure open communication throughout.
